subject: Urgent: 12-hour extension request for pilot while PO routing
messages:
From: Priya Sharma <priya@helixlabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Helix Labs Procurement <procurement@helixlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot hold — PO routing taking longer than expected

Hi Marissa,

Quick update from our side — procurement has the PO in a three-way review with legal and insurance (they flagged the data processing clause). They told us there’s a chance payment will not show as issued for another 24–48 hours. We’re mid-way through the pilot and losing momentum; the internal team asked whether Redwood can keep the sandbox live or provide a small buffer so our engineers can finish the integration tests.

Can you do a very short extension (12–24 hours) or a micro credit push to keep the environment available? If you need the PO, I attached the draft they shared this morning.

Attachment: Helix_PO_draft_0427.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — Priya
Priya Sharma
Head of Product
Helix Labs
priya@helixlabs.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@helixlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot hold — PO routing taking longer than expected

Hi Priya — thanks for the context and for sending the PO draft. I can temporarily extend the pilot timer for 12 hours immediately and push a 24-hour micro-credit hold to keep the sandbox up while procurement completes the final signoff.

Before I apply credits I need one internal quick-okay from Finance to make this exception (deal HLX-2027-042). Looping in Dylan and David for that approval. If they confirm, I’ll apply and send you an updated usage log.

Plan:
- Apply 24 hours of micro credits / 2,000 token allowance (non-billable)
- Freeze the trial countdown by 12 hours
- Send a short proof-of-life message when it’s active

If procurement confirms payment earlier, we’ll reverse the temporary credit and re-enable normal billing.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Marissa — quick internal note. Finance reviewed the draft PO and the deal history (HLX-2027-042). Given the low token volume and strong signal on procurement intent (Priya confirmed), we can approve a one-time micro-credit of 2,000 tokens and a 12-hour timer freeze. Please mark it as an exception and tag the HubSpot deal.

Steps I took/ask you to do after you apply:
- Mark credit entry as "Trial Bridge - PO Pending" in billing notes
- Attach Helix_PO_draft_0427.pdf to the billing record for audit
- Notify account team and Helix that credits will be revoked if PO is not received in 48 hours

Approved by: Dylan Brooks, Finance — internal approval code FIN-EX-77

Thanks — I’ll flag if anything changes.

Hi Priya — quick good news: Finance approved a one-time 2,000 token micro-credit and I’ve frozen the pilot timer for 12 hours starting now. You should see the sandbox remain responsive for the next 12 hours; the micro-credit shows on our end as "Trial Bridge - PO Pending" and I attached the PO draft to the billing note for audit.

Attachment: Trial_credits_log.txt (txt)

A few quick notes:
- If procurement confirms payment within 48 hours we’ll reconcile and transition to normal billing; if we don’t receive a PO in that window we’ll reverse the credit (we’ll give you a 12-hour warning if reversal is needed).
- If Helix needs more runway beyond that window, let us know and we’ll discuss escalation options with Sales and RevOps.

Thanks for keeping us posted — reach out if you hit blockers during the integration tests.

Best,
